title: Drift audit: an opt-in scheduled runner reads live zone rules via the Cloudflare API and diffs against the local manifest, reporting mismatches metadata-only
description: The blueprint ships a scheduled drift-audit runner (TAC-3703) the applying project can wire behind the elicited rate-limit-drift-audit-cadence per ADR-3704. When enabled (daily or hourly), the runner fetches the live rate-limiting rules on the elicited zone via the Cloudflare API, diffs the returned rule set against the local manifest field-by-field, and constructs one drift-audit record per mismatched rule. The drift-audit record has the metadata-only shape {ruleId, outcome, timestamp, diff}; it never carries clientIpHash (there is no client on the API path), never a full IP, never a request body, never a user agent. Runtime request-event records (a separate record class produced by the live gate, not by the drift-audit runner) have the shape {ruleId, clientIpHash, outcome, timestamp} where clientIpHash is a hashed IP prefix. The runner report artefact writes to .rcf/reports/blueprints/edge-cloudflare-rate-limiting/. When the elicited cadence is off, the runner is not wired.
rationale: Ratified in the Cloudflare round 6 spec (cloudflare-round-6-spec-2026-09-06.md section 5.6). Ships as v1.0.0 of edge-cloudflare-rate-limiting.
